candidates.name: D10 Specialties, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage service 'Bathroom Accessories & Partitions: install of restroom accessories, partitions, grab bars, and wall protection systems' for general contractors.
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 installer working for general contractors in Northwest Arkansas, and its site names partition installation. It is installation-only as far as the site says. The site gives no base city or office phone, only two named staff with phone numbers (left out as possible personal lines).
red_flags: No base city or main office phone on the site

license.name: D10 Specialties, LLC
license.registry: Arkansas Contractors Licensing Board, Find a Licensed Contractor (aclb2.arkansas.gov/clbsearch.php)
license.note: Could not check the license. The board's only online search, linked from the page above and from portal.arkansas.gov/service/licensed-contractor-search, is http://aclb2.arkansas.gov/clbsearch.php, and it returned HTTP 503 or reset the connection on every try on 2026-11-20. The company site (https://d10-specialties.com/) serves general contractors across Northwest Arkansas and names no base city. It lists 'Bathroom Accessories & Partitions' (install of restroom accessories, partitions, grab bars, wall protection) and shows no license number. Arkansas requires a commercial license for jobs of $50,000 or more, so many partition installs fall under that amount. Next step: confirm by phone with the board, or check the online search again later.

candidates.name: GoPunchlist (division of Specialty Construction Solutions, LLC)
candidates.partition_evidence: Restrooms page: provides and installs restroom partitions (HDPE, stainless, powder-coated steel, laminate, phenolic) and sells parts (doors, panels, pilasters, headrails, brackets).
candidates.reason: Springdale-based commercial installer serving all of Northwest Arkansas, and it installs restroom partitions and accessories. It also supplies partitions and parts itself, so there is a buy-around risk.
red_flags: Supplies and sells partitions and parts itself (buy-around risk)
